identity: An offline-first iPhone Home Screen utility that makes Apple Notes-style gym logging easier while keeping Apple Notes as the canonical archive.
purpose: Reduce the interaction cost of maintaining a large Apple Notes workout log without adding accounts, cloud sync, analytics, or generic fitness-platform features.

authoritativeDocs.role: Implementation decisions that preserve the specification
Engineering state, tasks, reviews, evidence, and reports

productChatRole: Product authority and human interface. It can consume the published packet and decide unresolved product questions, but it does not accept worker claims as verification.

bridge.recommendedUpgrade: If the product conversation can write through the GitHub app, use one append-only comment on the configured product-sync issue. If it can only update files, commit one JSON artifact under orchestration/product-sync/inbox/.
bridge.minimumUserAction: Connect the repository in the product conversation, ask it to read orchestration/product-sync/PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md, and let the local Codex loop run poll-decisions.
bridge.why: The current GitHub connector exposes supported file and issue-comment writes to tooling, but this environment cannot verify or grant write permission to a particular existing ChatGPT conversation, and it cannot inject or wake that conversation.
